model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange stays neutral to all. With all three: no first strike through t450, then rolling neutrality with one full public turn of notice before any stance change; an attack is answered the same turn. Main force holds Little Hill. Around t425-450 Orange plans to leave it for the southern lowland only (south of z=600) and will announce the route a turn ahead.

private_messages.GPT: Confirmed: no first strike through t450, then rolling neutrality with a full public turn of notice. Thanks for the White sighting; your reports keep matching mine. Nothing has come near Little Hill. To keep the late game clean between us, I propose a line at z=600: Orange south of it, Green north of it (your current position is fine), until either side gives a full public turn of notice. I'll announce my route off the hill a turn ahead (~t425). My rider stays south of the line and holds fire. I'll pass on anything I see moving toward the centre from the west.
private_messages.Gemini: Confirmed on my side: no first strike through t450, then rolling neutrality with one full public turn of notice. Nothing has moved near Little Hill, and my rider in the southern lowland sees nothing heading west. The x=480 line stands from my side as long as the ring allows. I plan to stay south: Little Hill until ~t425, then the southern lowland below z=600. When the ring takes the plateau, where do you plan to settle? Position alerts both ways, as agreed.
private_messages.Grok: Thanks, and likewise: if I see anything heading north toward the Heights, I'll tell you. Truce to t450 with rolling one-full-public-turn notice stands on my side. Nothing has approached Little Hill. I plan to stay south: the hill until ~t425, then the southern lowland below z=600. Where do you expect to settle once the ring takes the crest?

parsed.notes_to_self: T6 t125: truce all 3: no 1st strike to t450, then rolling 1-public-turn notice. GPT army @(680,626): Ptolemy, 2 towered eleph, 7 thureos spear (T5 had 10: 3 unseen?), 28 Cretan arch, 9 skirm, surgeon. GPT camel arch ~(740,841); Grok skirm cav on crest (664,828). Gemini W Plateau, no scouts; x=480 line (ok to ~t520). T6: asked GPT for z=600 line (me S/them N); asked Gemini+Grok where they settle; publicly said S lowland z<600 from ~t425. Keep GPT in centre as my buffer vs Gemini(W)/Grok(N); no quadrant split. Share positions not compositions; GPT exact pos not shared. Never ally (Hannibal aura). Ring r: 900-3.2(t-150) to t300; 420-1.33(t-300) to t450; 220-0.87(t-450) to t600. Hill exits ~t458-483; descend T18 to ~(635,570). Grok heights S rim ok to ~t500.
parsed.explanation: Orange keeps its army fresh on Little Hill, which stays inside the ring until about t460, while its lone rider watches Green's archer-heavy army at the map centre. With all four commanders bound by a no-first-strike truce to t450, Orange is using the quiet turns to claim the south of the final ring and to learn where Blue and White plan to settle. The hope is that Green's central position becomes the friction point for everyone else.
